title: drymaria divaricata var. viscidula
intro: Drymaria divaricata var. viscidula, commonly known as Sticky Chickweed, is a perennial herb belonging to the Caryophyllaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in wound healing, skin conditions, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Sticky Chickweed include its ability to reduce inflammation, modulate the immune system, and exhibit antioxidant activity, making it a potential remedy for various health concerns. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
